metadata.title: Kasol to Manali Via Naggar Food Trip | Naggar Castle Bakery Rum ball + Cheese Spinach/Kothey Momo
metadata.description:
After spending a peaceful day in Kasol, we set off for Manali the next morning with our gracious host Khushboo, for whom Himachal truly feels like a second home. We began our day with breakfast at Kailasha - The Himalayan Village. It was raining gently, and the meal felt soulful and comforting. The spread included assorted fruits, garlic bread, dalia pulao, idli, and coffee - all homestyle and served in a serene setting.
On our way to Manali, we made a quick stop at Naggar Castle, a popular and historic site known for its beautiful wood and stone architecture and panoramic views of the valley. Just nearby, we stumbled upon a charming homemade bakery that’s a hit with tourists. Their rum ball and carrot cake are quick to sell out – and we were lucky to get our hands on them.
Not long after, we noticed a makeshift honey stall along the road. The owner explained how honey is cultivated using artificial hives inside boxes, which are later processed and reused. We tasted three types of honey, each one unique in flavor.
We then reached Sunbloom Cafe and met its passionate owner who shared the journey of how this scenic cafe came into being. The outdoor seating was inviting and peaceful. We enjoyed fresh juice and delicious spinach momos before continuing on.
By the time we arrived in Manali, it was evening and we were hungry. We kept dinner simple - comforting dal roti at Beas Punjabi Dhaba. A satisfying end to a day full of scenic views, and soulful food.
